map.APY 实际年化收益率计算器，输入名义年利率与复利次数按 (1+r/n)^n−1: APY effective annual yield calculator: enter the nominal annual rate and the number of compounding periods and compute the effective annual yield as (1 + r/n)^n - 1, to help compare investment products.
map.APY=(1+r/n)^n−1，r 为名义年利率、n 为每年复利次数；反映不同复: APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1, where r is the nominal annual rate and n the number of compounding periods per year; it reflects the true annualised return at different compounding frequencies, the higher the frequency the larger the APY, and the upper bound is continuous compounding e^r - 1.
map.→ 打开由名义利率与复利频率求实际年化收益率工具: -> Open the effective annual yield from nominal rate and compounding frequency tool
map.名义 5%、按月复利的实际年化: Effective annual yield of a nominal 5% compounded monthly
map.在名义利率固定时，复利越频繁（日利>月利>年利）实际年化越高，但存在上限——连续: With a fixed nominal rate, more frequent compounding (daily over monthly over annual) gives a higher effective annual yield, but there is a ceiling: continuous compounding A = P * e^(rt), and going more frequent never exceeds e^r - 1.

map.把银行标称的「年化 X%、按月复利」折算成可比的实际年化。: Convert a bank advertised "X% annualised, compounded monthly" into a comparable effective annual yield.
map.数值上两者是同一公式 (1+r/n)^n−1。APY 多指存款/货基的「实际收益: Numerically the two use the same formula (1 + r/n)^n - 1. APY usually refers to the effective yield on deposits and money market funds, while EAR usually refers to the effective annual rate on loans; the calculation is the same.
